en: Oh, I don't mean as a wife, mind you.
note: 'yome-san toshite' = as a wife/bride; Jus's joke that he is not inviting the player as a bride (he and Vent are unmarried, see #894)

en: I'm saying come over and visit, no need to hold back.
Oh yeah, how about some furniture for your house?
I'll make gatepost stakes too, if needed.
A skilled man can be put to use as a servant.
note: speaker is the stern player voice; 'a skilled man' = Jus (referent inferred from message under Jus)

en: He will surely become a fine strength to me.
note: 'He' = the skilled man / Jus; literal 'my good strength'

en: Mwahahaha...
note: also used in msg 99338 (Celia, after 'holding preserved food'); works for both

en: If you like, why don't we have dinner together?
You came at just the right time.
I was just about to eat.
Eat with me.
Hey, what's your name?
note: followed by player 'My name is ' (#128) + name

en: I am interested, but as for the work...
I'd welcome that, though.
note: continues #869 'If you'd help me out,' (slice 010)

en: Neither Vent nor I have taken a wife yet,
so we live together.
, my master. Whatever you say,
note: name is inserted before the row; ', my master' from a thrall, matches #0

en: I'll do anything...
Give me your orders...
note: after #0 ', my master...'

en: Hm... haven't we met somewhere before?
No. I have never met you.
I see. Guess not.
We have, right? Yeah, we must have...
note: follows #899 'haven't we met somewhere before?' in msg 41660

en: I'm just heading into the forest.
I'm heading into the forest. Want to come along?
Hey there.
note: 'konchiwa' greeting; 'Hey there.' used in daytime/evening/home contexts alike

en: Oh, I see...
Is that so?
Night's coming earlier these days.
If I don't hurry home, night will catch me.
I'm heading home now. Want to come along?
Hm... who are you again?
The real question is who you are.
note: player after '{NAME}.' (#8); stern 'you are the one who should say who you are'

en: I'm Vent...
Hm... you walk into someone else's house,
note: Vent answering the player who asked who he is: the player entered the brothers' house

en: and then ask who I am? What's that about?
You let someone into your house, then ask who they are? That makes no sense.
note: player to Vent: Vent let him in himself, so asking 'who are you' is absurd; 'they' kept neutral

en: Uh... hmm...
I thought you were a guest of my brother's.
Then it's no wonder I don't know you.
note: inferred: player is Jus's guest, so he has never met Jus's brother Vent; 'I don't know you'

en: That was a pointless exchange. I'll come again.
note: no used_in message found; player's remark on leaving, rendered literally

en: Ah... you...
(To deal with humans,
note: player's inner thought, continues in #923

en: I must learn to maneuver a little more skillfully.)
You...
Ugh, come on. Why are you here again?
Oh, it's you.
note: works with #927 and #931 (msg 41926, 41956)

en: It's just my brother and me living here.
Yeah, I chop the trees down,
and my brother makes all kinds of things.
That's how our work goes.
As for what gets done with the trees I cut,
ask my brother.
Well, he's not the only one who uses them.
note: 'he' = my brother; 'them' = the trees/wood from #931

en: I can haul in loads of wood, after all.
Welcome. There's nothing much here,
note: 'Not that there's anything in this house' folded into 'nothing much here'; #936 starts with 'but'

en: but if you want to investigate anything,
note: starts with 'but' to continue #935 (msg 41986)

en: go right ahead.
note: 'investigate' = the game's investigate command

en: Want to check out my strength?
I'm proud of my strength. It's really something.
Come to the forest and I'll show you some amazing skills.
Hey, it's dangerous to be around here.
I'm a woodcutter, so I'm cutting trees.
Did you have business in the forest?
But it's dangerous to be around here.
Still here, huh?
Hurry up and get out of here.
Do you have business in the forest?
Or do you have business with me?
I keep hearing all sorts of rumors about you lately.
What are you really up to?
Just a little investigation.
note: player: 'a little investigation'

en: Studying something complicated, are you?
Are you some kind of scholar?
Come to think of it, you do look like one.
What good is investigating a woodcutter?
note: literal 'investigate'; continues in #956 'There are all sorts of uses.'

en: There are all sorts of uses.
Besides, you look strong.
Heh, nobody beats me in a contest of strength.
I'm the best around here.
